summary: chore(deps): upgrade mailparser to 3.x in auth-server test mail helper
description:
Because:

* mailparser 0.6.1 is old, and only the auth test mail helper uses it
* the 3.x parser is async and returns a different mail shape

This commit:

* upgrades mailparser to 3.x in fxa-auth-server
* ports mail_helper to simpleParser and keeps the 0.x mail shape
* copies messageId into the legacy shape for the resend specs
* stores mail in arrival order and accepts only after the store
* times out or rejects a bad mail so later mail is not stalled

Closes FXA-5351
